beads_commands.name: complete acceptance criteria
beads_commands.stdout_tail: Updated tdmem-0201: Define the provider capability registry

argv: Accepted the corrected V1 provider capability registry with explicit mandatory/optional classes, complete per-capability semantics, and inert lossless handling of unknown versioned capabilities.

Evidence: product/contracts/memory-provider-v1/provider-registry-contract.json makes capability_registry the authority, separates provider.health/observation/recall mandatory capabilities from twelve optional behaviors, and defines ordered inputs, outputs, typed failures, compatibility, advisory authority, and detailed contract gates for every entry. Unknown canonical capability records preserve their opaque payload byte-for-byte across decode/encode, remain excluded from requested or activated sets, and return typed capability_unsupported when explicitly required. The legacy capability_catalog remains only a derived ID projection. The strict schema, README, repository validator, and mutation tests enforce class separation, full operation semantics, duplicate/version rules, exact scope, no provider-name branching, no silent fallback, NCM/OCEAN deferral, and unknown-capability round-trip/non-activation. Handshake and observation cross-contract convergence is deliberately verified when tdmem-0202 and tdmem-0203 close.
